name: PI
description: PI returns the value of the mathematical constant π (pi), approximately 3.14159265358979.

basicExample.explanation: PI() returns the constant π to about 15 digits of precision.

howItWorks: PI() is a constant function that returns the value of π (the ratio of a circle's circumference to its diameter), accurate to the worksheet's 15-digit floating-point precision. It takes no arguments.

howToSteps.name: Select the cell
howToSteps.text: Click the cell for the result.

limitations: PI takes no arguments; supplying one (e.g. PI(1)) returns #VALUE!.
Precision is limited to the worksheet's ~15 significant digits.
It returns a static constant, not a function of any input.

commonErrors.cause: Arguments were passed to PI, such as PI(1).

googleSheetsEquivalent.description: PI works identically in Google Sheets.

faq.question: Do I need to pass anything to PI?
faq.answer: No. PI takes no arguments; call it as =PI() with empty parentheses.
